# Dev container setup

Make a dev container for this project so builds match on every machine. Pick the base image from the language, put the project at /workspaces/app, and bring the person's whole home along into the container (writable, as the dev user's home) so their keys, dotfiles and tool logins keep working without setup. Let the assistant work anywhere in that home too, so it can fix config problems wherever they are. When it is built, tell them the project is mounted and the container is ready.
